$comment: Mana, elements and spells. Mana is NOT a commodity: it has no bulk, sits in no stockpile, and cannot be crated. It lives in bodies (rarely - see peoples.json manaStorage) and in talismans (items.json, class talisman), tracked with a token on the talisman's mana bar. Mana crystals in commodities.json are a different thing: frozen mana as a trade good and potion ingredient - a crystal can be shattered by its holder to yield 2 mana of any one element, but mana can never be pressed back into a crystal.

elements.name: Fire
elements.summary: Heat, forge-work, hunger. At home in the desert and under the mountains.

elements.name: Earth
elements.summary: Stone, root, patience. At home in hills, barrows and old woods.

elements.name: Water
elements.summary: Current, mist, depth. At home in marsh, shore and open sea.

elements.name: Air
elements.summary: Wind, cold, distance. At home on the tundra and the high passes.

mana.gained: Slaying a monster yields its manaYield in mana of its element, to the characters who fought it. Some quests and hoards yield mana directly.
mana.stored: Mana must be held: in a body with innate capacity (elves, up to 3) or in a talisman. Mana gained with nowhere to hold it blows away at the end of the round.
mana.element: Stored mana keeps its element. A talisman can hold a mix - note each element's share beside the bar.
mana.traded: Characters in the same hex may pass mana freely between talismans. Mana in a talisman is stolen with the talisman.
mana.spent: On spells, below. Spells state their element; mana of the wrong element does not cast them.

spells.name: Kindle
spells.effect: Light: the caster's party counts as carrying a torch until dawn (nothing to spend), or light any fire without fuel - a furnace so lit runs one batch without paying its fuel.

spells.name: Ember Lash
spells.effect: +2 combat dice to one unit or character for one battle.

spells.name: Mend Stone
spells.effect: Repair 2 damage on one building or vehicle, or restore 4 wear to one tool.

spells.name: Bulwark
spells.effect: One unit or character ignores 2 hits in one battle.

spells.name: Cleanse
spells.effect: Cure one illness marker, or restore 2 health to one character.

spells.name: Mist Veil
spells.effect: Treat one monster, bandit or pirate discovery result as Nothing. Cast after the roll.

spells.name: Fair Wind
spells.effect: +2 hexes on one leg, any mode. A ship gets +3.

spells.name: Stormcall
spells.effect: One party, vehicle or cargo you can see loses its next leg entirely.

casting.who: Any character holding the mana - innately or in a carried talisman. Workers and soldiers do not cast.
casting.when: Any time its effect makes sense; combat spells before hits are applied, Mist Veil after the discovery roll.
casting.limit: One spell per character per round.
casting.notes: The spell list is deliberately short and economic, like the potion list: hours, movement, safety, repair. When the list grows, it grows here - and it should probably become a deck.
